exercises.prompt: Bangun analisis September: hitung revenue, parse month, merge category, lalu ringkas revenue per category.
exercises.incorrect_feedback: Periksa seluruh alur dari read_csv sampai filter 2025-09, merge, groupby, sum, dan sort_values.
exercises.success_feedback: Benar. Kamu menghubungkan langkah teknis menjadi alur analisis yang dapat diulang.

interactive.starter_code:
import pandas as pd

transactions = pd.read_csv("transactions.csv")
products = pd.read_csv("products.csv")
transactions["revenue"] = transactions["quantity"] * transactions["unit_price"]
transactions["order_date"] = pd.to_datetime(transactions["order_date"])
transactions["month"] = transactions["order_date"].dt.to_period("M").astype(str)
sales = transactions.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
september = sales[sales["month"] == "2025-09"]
summary = september.groupby("category", as_index=False)["revenue"].sum().sort_values("revenue", ascending=False)
print(summary)
